title: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: A timeless favorite featuring fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil.
steps: Preheat the oven to 500°F (260°C).
Stretch the dough and spread tomato sauce evenly.
Top with mozzarella slices and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake until the crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Finish with fresh basil leaves and a pinch of salt.

title: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken
description: Juicy grilled chicken marinated with lemon, garlic, and herbs.
steps: Marinate chicken with lemon, garlic, herbs, and oil for 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill chicken 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Avocado Toast Deluxe
description: Creamy avocado spread on crunchy toast with optional toppings.
steps: Toast the sourdough slices.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread on toast and top with chili flakes.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Rich and savory meat sauce served over al dente spaghetti.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato puree and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Serve sauce over spaghetti.

title: Quinoa Veggie Bowl
description: A wholesome bowl of quinoa topped with roasted veggies and tahini.
steps: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Roast chopped veggies with oil, salt, and pepper at 400°F (200°C) for 20–25 minutes.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to thin.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, veggies, chickpeas, and drizzle tahini dressing.

title: Beef Tacos
description: Seasoned ground beef in warm tortillas with fresh toppings.
steps: Cook ground beef with taco seasoning.
Warm tortillas in a pan.
Assemble tacos with beef and toppings.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
description: Comforting tomato soup with fragrant basil and cream.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes and broth, simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth; add cream and basil.

title: Berry Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of yogurt, granola, and fresh berries.
steps: Layer yogurt, granola, and berries in a glass.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

title: Garlic Shrimp Pasta
description: Garlicky shrimp tossed with spaghetti and parsley.
steps: Cook spaghetti until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add shrimp and cook until pink.
Toss shrimp with pasta, lemon juice, and parsley.

title: Caprese Salad
description: Fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil with balsamic glaze.
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Layer with basil leaves, drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
